title: Soft Cinnamon Rolls with Cream Cheese Icing
summary: A rich milk, egg and butter dough is rolled out, spread with a brown sugar, cinnamon and butter paste, rolled up and sliced into 12 rolls. They prove in one tin, bake until golden and are spread with a tangy cream cheese icing while warm.
equipment: 23 x 33 cm baking tin lined with baking paper

ingredients.item: fine sea salt or table salt

steps.title: Dough
steps.text: Knead the dough until soft and smooth and leave it to double.

steps.title: Filling
steps.text: Beat the butter, brown sugar and cinnamon to a paste.

steps.title: Roll
steps.text: Roll the dough out, spread with filling and roll up tightly.

steps.title: Cut
steps.text: Slice into 12 rolls and prove in the tin until puffy.

steps.title: Bake
steps.text: Bake until golden and 88 °C in the centre.

steps.title: Ice
steps.text: Spread the cream cheese icing over the warm rolls.

tips: Use a serrated knife or unflavoured dental floss for neat slices.
Very soft butter spreads without tearing the dough.
Shape the rolls the night before, chill them covered, and bake in the morning.
storage: Keep covered at room temperature for up to 2 days, or freeze un-iced for up to 1 month and warm before serving. Cool leftovers in a shallow container and refrigerate within 2 hours (within 1 hour on a day above 32°C).
